chapters.text: Deals are your closed sales, each with its commission form; then installments and payments.
A deal is made when a sale is closed: on the lead press Close deal and fill in the commission form. New deal on the Deals page does the same for a client without a lead.
Deals → Closed deals lists them newest first with the property, value, commission and closing date. All deals also shows older open and lost deals, with the board.

Open a deal: the Commission form card shows unit no., community, project, developer, value, commission (% and amount), the agent's and company's share in rupees, other agents and the payment structure. Edit commission form changes it.
A unit picked from Inventory is linked and marked sold.
Payments: create a payment plan (down payment + installments), then record each payment as it comes in.
